text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way back from an outing near the station with Mejiro Dober—

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Dad!
Let's stop by the shrine festival~! Pretty please?

text_block_list.name: Girl's Father
text_block_list.text: Can't be helped then, but only for a little bit, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh, there's a festival going on today...?
...Hmm.
choice_data_list: If you're curious, should we go check it out?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!? I-I'm fine...!
It's not like I care anyway!
choice_data_list: Then I'd like you to come with me.
Then I want you to come with me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...I-It's fine.
I was just thinking, 'Oh, really?' is all."
choice_data_list: Then I'd like you to come with me.
Then I want you to come with me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
W-Wait a second—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
W-Wait a second—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Honestly.
You're really so pushy—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...*Sigh*, only for a little bit, okay?
Huh, Belle?
Huh, Belle?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Dad!?
Why are you here...!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text: I happened to be in town on a business trip! I was just on my way to see Belle-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wait...! I'm not a kid anymore,
so stop calling me Belle-chan!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, yeah. After all, here I am,
giving it my all at Tracen Academy."

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Thank you for always looking after my daughter.
I've heard so much about you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I-It's nothing...!
I was just giving you a normal status update, okay...!?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well...
you do need a progress report for now, right?

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
My daughter seems so grateful to you.
Please continue to take good care of her!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
My daughter seems so grateful to you.
Please continue to take good care of her!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hey!
Cut it out, seriously...!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't butt in where you're not needed...!
I always make sure to express my gratitude properly anyway.

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
A festival, huh. Brings back memories.
We used to go around them together when we were little, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
A festival, huh. Brings back memories.
We used to go around them together when we were little, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...That was back when I was little, you see.

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
Fireworks went off near the end of the festival...
Bel-chan was so cute back then~.

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~! So many big shooting stars!
I have to make a wish quickly!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! That's a bit different from a shooting star.
Those are called fireworks.

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh?! It's a shooting star!
It's gonna make my wish come true!

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text:
Star light, star bright...
Please let me become an amazing Umamusume
who can win big races too...!!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text: ...Or so they said.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What's with that look? Are you making fun of me...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"D-Don't laugh at me...!
I can tell them apart properly now!"

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Still, I'm glad to see you're doing well.
I was worried you might be pushing yourself too hard now that you're out in the public eye.

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Still, I'm glad to see you're doing well.
I was worried you might be pushing yourself too hard now that you're out in the public eye.

text_block_list.name: Dober's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, I'd love to stay a bit longer,
but I should get going. See you, Bel-chan."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's why you're—
...Geez, see you later.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...
I thought I had grown at least a little after stepping onto the center stage, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Even so... the fact that I'm making everyone worry
must mean I'm still too immature.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I-It's nothing...!
Y-You have nothing to do with this anyway...!"
choice_data_list: Let's do even better and show them what you're made of!
Your father recognizes your worth, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... But still...
I can't help but worry just a little bit.
choice_data_list: Let's do even better and show them what you're made of!
Your father recognizes your worth, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: More...
choice_data_list: So much that all your worries will disappear!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: More...
choice_data_list: So much that all your worries will disappear!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to tell me that...! I'm gonna keep on winning
and become an amazing Umamusume that everyone acknowledges!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, nothing will start
unless we take action instead of moping around.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...That's why I'm gonna become even stronger than I am now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna get stronger.
Much, much stronger than I am now...!
Strong enough to make my dad proud...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober's intense gaze
clearly showed her determination.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober's intense gaze
clearly showed her determination.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what...!
Don't act like you know everything about me...!
choice_data_list: Because I could tell how much you cherish your daughter
Because I could tell how much you cherish your daughter

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...How can you say that with such certainty?
You're not my father, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Because I could tell how much you cherish your daughter
Because I could tell how much you cherish your daughter

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...He's just an overdoting dad.
Ever since I was little, he's been overprotective, a worrywart, seriously...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I see... Then you understand, right?
Knowing how much I'm loved makes it even more frustrating. I feel so pathetic for making them worry.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...*Sigh*. I need to get stronger,
if only to help her let go of me a little.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'll get stronger.
Much, much stronger than I am now...
Enough to make Dad proud...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though Mejiro Dober let out a weary sigh,
her determination to become stronger seemed unshakeable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober's intense gaze
clearly showed her determination.
